'''Rancor Aid''' was a drink developed by escaped [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] on the planet [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. It was a tasty beverage made from the skin of local [[Rancor/Legends|Rancors]] that replenished the body's electrolytes.
